messages:
Iris (Design): dropped a compact prototype for model catalog compare + filters: https://figma.com/file/compact . main questions: how persistent should filters be across pages? and what's the keyboard flow when chips collapse?
Theo (PM): users expect filters to stick when they switch to compare and back. also support needs short shareable links for repro.
Rae (A11y): chips must be real buttons with aria-pressed and explicit aria-labels. when chips collapse into a menu, ensure menu button announces count.
Jon (Frontend): idea: use URL token for shareable state + session storage for back/forward. rule: query param wins if present. keeps behaviour predictable.
Priya (FE): encoding filters as compact base64 helps but opaque. alternative: server-side short token (/catalog?s=abc) for long sets. needs API owner.
Iris (Design): UX: show small banner "Filters restored from last session — Restore filters" with a real button. primary left control should read "Clear filters".
Rae (A11y): banner should be role="status" and the restore button labelled clearly. after restore, focus goes to first active chip.
Jon (Frontend): compare modal focus: trap focus, land on first sortable column header so keyboard users can start navigating the table.
Priya (FE): pinning: prefer account-level pins synced to profile; fallback session for guests. tooltip: "Pin this model version for comparisons".
Iris (Design): badge contrast issue: small colored badges fail AA. switch to outline + small icon (lightning) so color is decorative and text/icon meet contrast.
Rae (A11y): add aria-label like "Performance: 42 ms" on badge container and mark decorative svgs aria-hidden.
Theo (PM): actions: Iris to update figma (toast copy + outline badge + pin tooltip); Rae to draft A11y checklist (chips, toast, modal focus, badges); Jon & Priya to prototype URL token vs server token + pin sync. follow-up in 24h.
design-bot: Reminder: quick follow-up review scheduled in 24h. :bell:
Iris (Design): small copy tweak: change toast action to "Restore filters" instead of "Undo". will update.
Jon (Frontend): will try compact token POC and share a decoding link.
Priya (FE): pairing with Jon later. resolving this thread until POC ready. :white_check_mark:
